classification_legend.D: engineering or determinism modification without statistical effect

global_contract.candidate_population: one immutable candidate search per strict search fingerprint
global_contract.final_psm_population: finite rank-1 candidates only; lower ranks are fitting/null observations and are scrubbed from final DF fields
global_contract.null_window: dataset-local and model-local; selected with measured entrapment FDP and locked before target-only analysis
global_contract.probabilities: finite and bounded in [0,1], with smaller p-value/PEP representing stronger evidence
global_contract.q_values: BH/Storey-family adjustment for p-native streams; best-first cumulative-mean PEP for PEP-native streams; monotone after ordering
global_contract.aggregation: rank-1 PSM -> canonical peptide (I/L canonicalized, modifications removed) -> peptidoform (modifications retained, I/L canonicalized) -> inferred protein key
global_contract.ratio_correction: E*(1+1/r)/(T+E), using measured peptidoform ratio in PSM/peptidoform space, measured canonical-peptide ratio at peptide level, and measured protein ratio at protein level
global_contract.failure: mandatory base fit unavailable is fail-closed; optional-stage failure retains the last-good active stream; not-evaluable is never a pass

msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.source_basis: Peng et al. require finite skew-normal mixtures with positive scales and estimable mixture weights; the paper and author implementation fit three parameters per component. Sage uses binary64 scores and deterministic weighted-moment updates.
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.input_validity: every supplied score is finite; each required population has n>=20; range>r and stable population standard deviation>r
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.parameter_validity: every location, scale, shape, and mixture weight is finite; every component scale>r; every required mixture weight is greater than 64*f64::EPSILON and its complement is valid
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.effective_support: expected aggregate support is at least 3 for every three-parameter skew-normal component
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.component_distinctness: each semantic component pair differs in location, scale, or shape by more than its 64-epsilon parameter-resolution tolerance
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.canonical_labels: 1SMix uses its existing deterministic upper-tail orientation. 2SMix labels are fixed by the non-exchangeable C/I1/I2 joint equations and deterministic initialization. Mean ordering is not required because the primary author implementation defaults to unconstrained component locations.
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.likelihood_rule: no additional improvement-over-nested-model threshold: neither the source method nor author code defines one, and adding one would be a new tuning rule rather than the minimal identifiability correction
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.valid_mixture: passes every rule and is returned byte-for-byte unchanged after validation
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.reduced_model: not an output of the declared MSFDR1/2 methods; boundary-component solutions fail technically
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.nonidentifiable: explicit technical failure; no artifact or probability stream
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.optimizer_failure: no configured trial yielded a valid fit, reported separately from the last trial-level reason
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.implementation_status: active for every newly fitted trial and every frozen MSFDR1/2 artifact before acceptance or serialization
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.targeted_regression: all six ISB MSFDR1/2 artifacts and result tables were byte-identical to the frozen baseline; MSFDR2 selected ranks 9-17; no fallback or external execution

moments.inputs: model-specific purified lower-rank hyperscore pool; rank-1 target candidates for application
moments.null: lower-rank score sampled from a common Gumbel(mu,beta)
moments.normalization: none beyond the selected rank-null population; optional bias-corrected winsorization is explicit
moments.pep: reference-population Storey pi0 plus Grenander decreasing-density local-FDR proxy
moments.q_value: configured p-native method, Storey by default with explicit BH fallback provenance
moments.target_only: refit or locked-artifact application are coherent only under their explicit workflow identity; the null window cannot be retuned

mle.inputs: model-specific purified lower-rank hyperscore pool; rank-1 candidates for application
mle.fit: stable Newton solution of beta-xbar+sum(x exp(-x/beta))/sum(exp(-x/beta))=0, then mu=beta*ln(n/sum(exp(-x/beta)))
mle.normalization: none; optional winsorization changes the likelihood target and is a declared sensitivity mode
mle.fallback: invalid/degenerate optimizer state makes the expert unavailable
mle.target_only: same interpretations and locked-window restriction as Moments

lower_order.inputs: spectrum-local tail probability and scored-candidate count; at least two supported lower-rank TEV buckets, normally stratified by charge
lower_order.null: asymptotic k-th lower-order extreme-value density exp(-k*z-exp(-z))/(beta*(k-1)!)
lower_order.score: E=p_tail*N^candidate_count_power*scale; TEV is the configured transform, canonically -ln(E)
lower_order.fit: per-rank TEV-k moments/MLE, then deterministic local linear extrapolation of nearest supported lower-order (mu_k,beta_k) states to rank 1
lower_order.p_value: rank-1 Gumbel upper-tail survival under extrapolated TNM
lower_order.minimum_data: at least two ranks, lo_min_count_per_rank finite observations per rank, and a valid positive beta
lower_order.target_only: refit_with_locked_window is coherent; complete-artifact reuse across the changed search space is rejected because both p_tail and N are search-space-dependent

msfdr.inputs: purified lower-rank pool to seed a fixed Gumbel null and rank-1 scores for mixture fitting
msfdr.fit: deterministic EM-like posterior updates with weighted-moment target updates and bounded pi
msfdr.pep: posterior null responsibility under the fitted two-component model
msfdr.q_value: PEP cumulative mean when PEP-native, otherwise configured p-native method
msfdr.fallback: too little seed/rank-1 data or invalid fit makes expert unavailable
msfdr.target_only: locked-window refit and identity-bound artifact reuse are distinguishable coherent analyses; neither may select a new window

msfdr1_smix.null: one rank-1 incorrect skew-normal component I1
msfdr1_smix.fit: S1=a*SN(C)+(1-a)*SN(I1); deterministic bottom/top multistarts, weighted-moment component updates, upper-tail orientation, and bounded a
msfdr1_smix.minimum_data: 20 finite rank-1 scores plus identifiable nondegenerate components
msfdr1_smix.target_only: rank-1 refit is coherent as a new mixture fit; complete reuse is coherent only as application of a locked model to the declared parent population
msfdr1_smix.correction_contract: the shared preregistered post-fit gate is applied to every multistart before likelihood ranking; the fixed rank-1/one-incorrect-component formulation has no reduced-model fallback
msfdr1_smix.step3_readiness: ready with the named source-estimator limitation; active identifiability and provenance tests pass

msfdr2_smix.inputs: rank-1 S1 and a selected pooled lower-rank S2 population
msfdr2_smix.null: I1 for rank-1; I1 and I2 for pooled S2
msfdr2_smix.identifiability: requires distinct component distributions and interior effective weights; exact pooled-row replication passed the predeclared 0.03 fitted-weight tolerance
msfdr2_smix.minimum_data: 20 finite S1 and 20 finite S2 scores plus identifiable nondegenerate components
msfdr2_smix.target_only: refit/reuse interpretations follow MSFDR, with locked pooled-rank window
msfdr2_smix.correction_contract: a nonidentifiable pooled-window trial is infeasible; another prospectively configured window may remain eligible, but no invalid artifact may be accepted or serialized
msfdr2_smix.step3_readiness: ready with the named pooled-likelihood limitation; active identifiability tests pass and the selected ISB window remains ranks 9-17

nokoi_v2.inputs: 12 normalized Sage features, stable candidate IDs, pseudo-positive rank-1 subset, and purified lower-rank nulls
nokoi_v2.null: out-of-fold scores for lower-rank null candidates
nokoi_v2.positive: configured top-slice/provisional-p pseudo-positive rule; entrapment labels are not training labels
nokoi_v2.classifier: L1-penalized logistic regression trained by deterministic FISTA with deterministic lambda selection
nokoi_v2.folds: stable-ID hash with seed 0x5EED5EED5EED5EED; fold-held nulls are scored out of fold
nokoi_v2.p_value: smoothed empirical upper-tail probability against sorted OOF null scores
nokoi_v2.q_value: PEP cumulative mean when PEP-native, otherwise configured p-native method
nokoi_v2.portable_state: feature contract, normalization, all fold/final weights and intercepts, lambda evaluations, stable identities, OOF null scores, pi0, Grenander blocks, p-to-PEP curve, hashes
nokoi_v2.target_only: refit with locked window is a new local crossfit; complete-artifact reuse is coherent only in SameDatasetTargetOnly mode with exact parent fingerprint

ensemble.inputs: every JSON-selected technically valid expert; missing/nonfinite values only are omitted
ensemble.second_best_p: second order statistic of finite expert p-values, or the sole value if one exists, else 1
ensemble.median_pep: sample median of finite expert PEP-like values, else 1
ensemble.dependence: raw second-best is robust consensus evidence but is not super-uniform over [0,1] even for three independent uniforms; median PEP is not a posterior without a joint expert-error model
ensemble.duplicate_experts: two or more identical experts reproduce their common value under second-best/median, increasing effective influence
ensemble.q_value: derived in the explicitly selected active evidence space
ensemble.participation: configuration-controlled; only technical invalidity excludes a selected voter
ensemble.interpretation_limit: call second-best output p-like consensus and median output PEP-like consensus, not calibrated probabilities absent empirical calibration
